note: Searched Victoria County TX. ArcGIS Online and Hub searches found no official zoning district service for Victoria County or the City of Victoria. The Zoning_Districts FeatureServer at services.arcgis.com/f4rR7WnIfGBdVYFd is not Texas (features in Alaska), and data-carver 'Victoria Zoning' is a different jurisdiction. Zoning is not published as a queryable service.
